name: Suno
shortDescription: Makes full songs with vocals and music from a text prompt.
bestFor: Making complete songs with vocals, or background music, from a description
about: Suno makes complete songs, with singing, music and lyrics, from a short description. You can write your own lyrics or let it write them, and choose any style from pop to qawwali-inspired.
It can also extend songs, make instrumentals for videos, and turn a hummed idea into a track.
features: Full songs with vocals from a prompt

howToUse.title: Sign up
howToUse.text: Create a free account at suno.com.

howToUse.title: Click Create
howToUse.text: Describe the song: style, mood, instruments and topic.

howToUse.title: Use Custom mode for your lyrics
howToUse.text: Paste your own lyrics and describe the style separately.

howToUse.title: Generate and pick
howToUse.text: Each generation gives you two versions. Keep the better one.

howToUse.title: Download
howToUse.text: Download the song. Check the licence before using it commercially.

tips: Name the genre, tempo and instruments: "slow acoustic, guitar and tabla, soft female vocals".
Use [Verse] and [Chorus] tags in your lyrics to shape the song.
examplePrompt: a happy birthday song for my sister Ayesha, upbeat pop with guitar and claps, simple catchy chorus
limitations: Songs made on the free plan can't be used commercially.
AI music law is still changing. Check Suno's current terms before using songs in paid work.
freePlanDetails: Daily free credits for a few songs. No commercial use.
pricingNote: US prices. Paid plans include commercial use rights for new songs.
